parts.text: Orc to Revus: please independently review this issue's workflow documentation candidate. Scope: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md, dev-first issue branches, exact-HEAD authorization and separate integration/acceptance/promotion gates. No implementation, extraction or merge is authorized. This message is a candidate trace, not an integrated record or proof that review has started.

Sol to Revex (copy Orc): PR #10 aligns root CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md with the accepted workflow, as tracked by Orc on #6 (comment 6949549255). Gaps closed: reviewer routing by implementing model (Codex including Devex and Doc -> Revus; Claude including Des and Sol -> Revex); only Orc's authorization of one exact HEAD allows Rel to merge (AGENTS.md step 3 no longer defers to the issue); separate staging GO and separate production GO by midas, production only after staging validation; an unavailable staging environment is an unmet gate that blocks release and production. Earlier gates kept; template/ unchanged and consistent; historical A2A lines untouched. Implemented by Claude, so Revex reviews.
